sloka: भृग्वङ्गिरसमम् दीप्त्या त्रिजटम् जनसम्सदि ।आ पन्चमायाः कक्ष्याया न एनम् कश्चित् अवारयत् ॥२-३२-३३॥
transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgirasamam dīptyā trijaṭam janasamsadi ।ā pancamāyāḥ kakṣyāyā na enam kaścit avārayat ॥2-32-33॥

translations.english: No one in the crowd stopped Tirjata until he reached the fifth courtyard as he looked like Bhrigu and Angirasa in brilliance.
